backends.profileMechanism: GPU-wide ADLX; WSGM applies/restores Switched values on game activation/exit; native profile sync intentionally no-op; display GlobalOnly
backends.lifecycle: Shared DriverRuntime serialized lane, observe10s/refresh20s; release features/items before services/Terminate; foreign initialization not terminated, epoch guards orphaned objects
backends.support: Service/interface/IsSupported/range/value checks per GPU/output; target PNP/ID/EDID revalidated; ADL mapping avoids fixed indices
backends.hardwareEvidence: User confirms AMD tested by another repository contributor; no fresh validation
backends.nativeAbi: ADLX C exports Cdecl; interface methods Stdcall; header2.0.0.125 negotiated to runtime version. IADLXSystem/IADLMapping no reference-count prefix; adlx_bool1 byte/int4 bytes/size pointer-sized. RSR selector14 and AFMF selector17 are service-wide Interface calls, not GPU-argument Feature calls.

extractionBoundaries.name: Native driver sessions
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Replace GPU plugin packages with direct native library backends. Vendor layouts, discovery, identity, controls, profiles, support probes and serialized calls belong in library.

extractionBoundaries.name: SDK independence
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Replace GPU dependencies on Device.Sdk descriptor/value/command/outcome/validation/Deadline/trace/section keys and Plugin.Sdk host/context/publications. Device SDK retires after handheld/GPU parity. Common Plugin SDK remains for IR/etc and must lose its existing Device SDK dependency.

extractionBoundaries.name: Application policy
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Global/game inheritance, user preferences, executable identity, foreground game activation/exit, reset/use-global and profile persistence remain in WSGM. Replace GpuCoordinator plugin channels with library state/actions.

extractionBoundaries.name: Frontend parity
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Both surfaces consume one backend; retain freshness, pins, focus and profile timing, use existing controls/styles.

extractionBoundaries.name: Windows display primitives
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Windows topology/target identity/HDR/resolution/refresh/layout/scaling remain WDC. Library owns vendor output-ID mapping and NVIDIA HDR10+ transition. Reconcile Intel local DisplayConfigGetDeviceInfo identity binding.

extractionBoundaries.name: Durable ownership and migration
extractionBoundaries.destination: Library mechanism with caller-supplied state directory
extractionBoundaries.requirements: Preserve Intel application-profiles.v1.json and color.v1.json and NVIDIA nvidia-profiles.v1.json, existing/external values, and saved WSGM gpu:<plugin-id> profiles/pins. Do not delete whole native profiles.
